mapper.select: SELECT o.id_ AS orderId, o.order_name AS orderName, o.order_type AS orderType, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.cust_name AS custName, o.order_category AS orderCategory, o.status_ AS status, o.phase_name AS phaseName, o.actors_info AS actorsInfo, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime, o.pi_id AS piId, o.business_dep AS businessDep, o.acc_nbr AS accNbr, o.creator_ AS creator, o.area_id AS areaId, area.name_ AS areaName, area.type_ AS areaType, c.name_ch AS creatorName, c.name_ AS creatorPhone FROM topp_order o LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON o.area_id = area.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON o.creator_ = c.id_ WHERE o.id_ = #{orderId}

SELECT his.ID_ AS taskId, his.TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS taskDefKey, his.NAME_ AS taskName, his.START_TIME_ AS startTime, his.END_TIME_ AS endTime, his.DURATION_ AS duration, su.name_ch AS assignee FROM act_hi_taskinst his LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id_ = TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM his.ASSIGNEE_) WHERE his.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{piId} ORDER BY his.START_TIME_ ASC
